title: India — sixth-largest economy cluster: PSB health + unclaimed deposits
summary: PSB Gross NPAs fell to ₹2,45,634 cr (31 Mar 2026); **GNPA ratio down to 1.93%**.

items: PSB Gross NPAs fell to ₹2,45,634 cr (31 Mar 2026); **GNPA ratio down to 1.93%**.

Unclaimed deposits with DEA Fund: ₹86,917.08 cr (30 Jun 2026); highest PSB: SBI (₹20,040 cr), then PNB, Canara; highest private bank: ICICI (₹2,278 cr), then HDFC, Axis. (Unclaimed = inoperative 10 yrs / term deposits unclaimed 10 yrs past maturity.).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — GNPA ratio 1.93% is a sharp standalone number.
